# How to Video Upscale with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to upscale a video to a higher resolution, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_video_upscale`

## Prompt

```text
Upscale a video to a higher resolution.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input video file id.
- `new_resolution` (optional): Target maximum side length after upscale, e.g. 2160. Default: 2160.
- `model_id` (optional): Video upscale model id. Default: video-upscale-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
